note: The daily quote picks one of these by date (rotates every day). Add your own — text + author.

quotes.text: The details are not the details. They make the design.
quotes.author: Charles Eames

quotes.text: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
quotes.author: Kent Beck

quotes.text: Design is not just what it looks like. Design is how it works.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Perfection is attained not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.text: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
quotes.author: John Johnson

quotes.text: Any fool can write code a computer understands. Good programmers write code humans understand.
quotes.author: Martin Fowler

quotes.text: Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
quotes.author: USMC adage

quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quotes.author: Alan Kay

quotes.text: Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Craft is the difference between what you meant and what you made.
quotes.author: Julius Bautista

quotes.text: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: The function of good software is to make the complex appear simple.
quotes.author: Grady Booch
